purpose: Increase distinct training EEG using permitted continuous recordings; keep held-out people out of all fitting

corpus.recordings: All14 runs of original phase2 training subjects, with50 recording annotation-review exclusions retained; actual raw allowlist sealed separately
corpus.preprocessing: Same sealed causal3–40Hz/200Hz recipe and maxabs500microvolt/minstd0.01microvolt/finite criteria; no clipping or rescaling
corpus.validation: Original phase2 validation subjects only; not trained on
corpus.final_QC_retained_counts: Pending independent preparation; no silent weakening of fixed rules

encoder.architecture: Same full64-channel compact EEGNet-style EEGEncoder as pinned phase2 model source
encoder.initialization: Fresh random initialization with seed20261122; not phase2 trained weights or external EEG-pretrained weights

masking.method: Sample96 distinct channel-time patches uniformly without replacement; set corresponding physical-V inputs to zero
masking.validation_mask_seed: First8 bytes of SHA256('20261122|val|'+id), big-endian uint64; constant at initial and every epoch

optimization.loss: Mean squared reconstruction error on exactly the masked samples only, in fixed Vx10000 units
optimization.batch_selection: Largest train-only sustained measured candidate within resource budget; exact candidates and seconds fixed by separate capacity/budget receipt before fitting

selection.if_initial_selected: Retain exact initial encoder; explicitly state that attempted adaptation did not improve the registered validation criterion

matched_MI_supervision.training_ids: Exact6359 phase2 train IDs; no test or new event targets
matched_MI_supervision.encoder: Selected SSL encoder, including initial if selected
matched_MI_supervision.task_heads: Fresh fixed-seed same binary heads as phase2
matched_MI_supervision.selection: Original phase2 left_right validation mean_subject_BA, missing-class groups omitted and counted, earliest tie

matched_frozen_LLM_alignment.prompts: Exact phase2 static task descriptions and both candidate labels; no target cue or event metadata

compute.status: Requires separately registered capacity and absolute-budget receipt; this scientific plan does not authorize GPU execution
compute.raw_transfer_method: Root to select existing identical ZIP copy or official retrieval with exact whole-file SHA; do not count identical release as newly acquired unique EEG
